prompt: If the fire alarm rings, (to leave) the room at once and (not / to use) the lift.
explanation_ru: В инструкции после if + Present Simple результат выражается повелительным наклонением: leave и отрицательное do not use.

prompt: Label on a shampoo bottle: If it gets into your eyes, ___ them with clean water.
explanation_ru: В инструкции после if + Present Simple ставится повелительная форма без to и без will: wash.

prompt: If you will feel ill on the bus, tell the driver.
answer: If you feel ill on the bus, tell the driver.
accepted_answers: If you feel ill on the bus, tell the driver.
explanation_ru: После if нельзя ставить will: в инструкции нужно Present Simple (feel) и повелительная форма в главной части.

prompt: Build the sentence.
answer: If you hear a strange noise, stop the machine.
accepted_answers: If you hear a strange noise, stop the machine.
explanation_ru: Инструкция строится как if + Present Simple, затем повелительная форма: If you hear …, stop …

prompt: A note on the washing machine in a shared flat: If the door (to stay) locked after a wash, (to wait) two minutes and try again. If it still does not open, (to call) the landlord. Please never force it.
explanation_ru: Это правила: после if идёт Present Simple (stays), а в главной части — повелительное наклонение (wait, call).

prompt: — My phone app keeps freezing. — Well, if an app (to freeze) like that, (to delete) it and install it again.
explanation_ru: Это общий совет-инструкция: после if — Present Simple (freezes), в главной части — повелительное наклонение (delete).

prompt: Saturday is market day, so ___ Saturday comes, the whole square fills with stalls.
explanation_ru: Суббота наступает наверняка, поэтому нужно when; if означало бы, что суббота может не наступить.

prompt: ___ you are allergic to any food, please tell the waiter before you order.
explanation_ru: Аллергия — лишь возможность, а не гарантированное событие, поэтому нужно if; when означало бы, что аллергия точно есть.

prompt: Milk always (to go) bad quickly if you (to leave) it outside the fridge on a hot day.
explanation_ru: Это общий факт, поэтому и в главной части, и после if используется Present Simple: goes, leave.

prompt: My cousin Hamza drives a delivery lorry, and he checks his tyres every Monday. He says that if the air (to get) colder, the pressure in a tyre (to go) down. If you (not / to check) it, the tyre wears out faster, and that costs money. So he always fills it up before a long trip.
explanation_ru: Это общие факты, поэтому после if и в главной части стоит Present Simple: gets, goes; отрицание — do not check.

prompt: Is each sentence a fact or a piece of advice?

items.text: If you press this key, the screen goes dark.
If a dog is scared, it hides under the table.
If I drink coffee late, I cannot sleep.
If the screen goes dark, press this key.
If a dog runs at you, stand still and stay calm.
If you cannot sleep, get up and read for a while.

explanation_ru: Если в главной части глагол в Present Simple — это факт или привычка; если повелительное наклонение — это совет.

prompt: Rules on a library notice board.
sentences: If you return a book late, you pay a small fine.
If you will lose a book, you pay for a new one.
You can borrow up to six books if you have a library card.
If a book is very popular, the library lends it for one week only.
The staff always help you if you would ask them.

fixes.1: If you lose a book, you pay for a new one.
fixes.4: The staff always help you if you ask them.

explanation_ru: В предложениях 2 и 5 после if стоят will и would; в общих правилах после if нужен Present Simple: lose, ask.

prompt: Jorge, I am leaving now. If Dad (to call), (to tell) him I will be back at six.
explanation_ru: Это просьба о конкретном будущем случае: после if — Present Simple (calls), а в главной части — повелительное наклонение (tell).

prompt: — I might miss the last bus. — Then, if you ___ it, call me and I will pick you up.
explanation_ru: После if в реальном будущем нельзя ставить will или would: нужен Present Simple (miss).

prompt: Tell Kiran to call me if you will see him at the party.
answer: Tell Kiran to call me if you see him at the party.
accepted_answers: Tell Kiran to call me if you see him at the party.
explanation_ru: После if нельзя ставить will; в условии о будущем используется Present Simple: if you see him.

prompt: Put the words in the right order.
answer: Please phone me if the train is late tomorrow.
accepted_answers: Please phone me if the train is late tomorrow.
explanation_ru: Просьба с условием о будущем: повелительная форма, затем if + Present Simple (is).

prompt: Odile is leaving for a week. She writes a note for her neighbour: Thank you for helping! If the weather (to be) hot, (to water) the plants twice a day. If a parcel (to arrive) for me, (to keep) it at your flat. I will be back next Sunday.
explanation_ru: После if о возможном будущем нужен Present Simple (is, arrives), а просьбы в главной части — повелительное наклонение (water, keep).

prompt: Wojtek will be away on Saturday and may lose his keys during the hike. His flatmate, who will stay at home, tells him what to do.
options: If you will lose your keys, ring me and I bring you another key.
If you lose your keys, you rang me and I will bring the spare ones.
If you lose your keys, ring me and I will bring you another key.
If you lost your keys, ring me and I will bring you another key.
explanation_ru: Возможное будущее: Present Simple после if, повелительное ring me и will bring в главной части.

prompt: If it (to be) sunny on Sunday, we can have lunch in the garden.
explanation_ru: После if о возможном будущем нужен Present Simple (is); can стоит в главной части.

prompt: Dilnoza says: You might get a discount if you (to ask) the manager nicely.
explanation_ru: После if нужен Present Simple (ask), а might стоит в главной части.

prompt: If my flight ___ on time, I might see you for dinner.
explanation_ru: В условии о возможном будущем после if стоит Present Simple (lands); will и would после if не употребляются.

prompt: Sipho is planning a weekend trip with friends. I am not sure about the camp site. If it (to be) full, we can sleep in the car. If the weather (to turn) bad, we may come home early. And if nobody (to bring) a tent, we should book a cheap hotel. I will let you know on Friday.
explanation_ru: Во всех условиях о возможном будущем после if стоит Present Simple (is, turns, brings), а модальные глаголы стоят в главной части.

prompt: You can watch a film tonight if you finish your homework early.
answer: You can watch a film tonight if you finish your homework early.
accepted_answers: You can watch a film tonight if you finish your homework early.
explanation_ru: Предложение верно: после if стоит Present Simple (finish), а can — в главной части.

prompt: Is it a habit or a plan for one future moment?

items.text: If my brother misses the bus, he walks to school.
If it snows, the trains usually run late.
If I am hungry at night, I eat bread and cheese.
If the weather is nice on Sunday, we will go to the lake.
If Mum calls this evening, I will tell her the news.
If the shop is still open when I get there, I will buy some bread.

explanation_ru: Привычка выражается Present Simple в обеих частях, а для одного будущего случая в главной части нужен will.

prompt: Our boss is strict about phones. If anyone ___ one in a meeting, he always takes it away.
explanation_ru: Слово always показывает привычное действие, поэтому в обеих частях Present Simple: uses, takes.

prompt: Next Monday, if the lift is still broken, I walk up to the sixth floor.
answer: Next Monday, if the lift is still broken, I will walk up to the sixth floor.
accepted_answers: Next Monday, if the lift is still broken, I will walk up to the sixth floor.
Next Monday, if the lift is still broken, I'll walk up to the sixth floor.
Next Monday, if the lift is still broken, I am going to walk up to the sixth floor.
Next Monday, if the lift is still broken, I'm going to walk up to the sixth floor.
explanation_ru: Речь об одном конкретном будущем случае, поэтому в главной части нужен will (walk), а не Present Simple.

prompt: If Mum (to say) yes, I (to go) to Zubair's party on Saturday.
explanation_ru: После if ставится Present Simple (says), а результат в будущем — will go.

prompt: I ___ you a message tonight if you give me your number.
explanation_ru: В главной части реального условия нужен will (will send); в условной части — Present Simple.

prompt: Chidi might get a day off next week. ___ he gets one, he will drive to Ibadan to see his aunt.
explanation_ru: Выходной может и не появиться, поэтому нужен if; when означало бы, что выходной точно будет.

prompt: My brother turns eighteen in March. ___ he turns eighteen, he will learn to drive.
explanation_ru: Восемнадцатилетие наступит обязательно, поэтому нужен when, а не if.

prompt: I will tell you if I will find a cheaper flight to Venice.
answer: I will tell you if I find a cheaper flight to Venice.
accepted_answers: I will tell you if I find a cheaper flight to Venice.
I'll tell you if I find a cheaper flight to Venice.
I’ll tell you if I find a cheaper flight to Venice.
explanation_ru: После if будущее выражается Present Simple: if I find, а не if I will find.

prompt: Hurry up, or you will miss your train. → If you …
answer: If you do not hurry up, you will miss your train.
accepted_answers: If you do not hurry up, you will miss your train.
If you do not hurry up, you'll miss your train.
If you do not hurry, you will miss your train.
If you do not hurry, you'll miss your train.
If you don't hurry up, you will miss your train.
If you don't hurry up, you'll miss your train.
If you don't hurry, you will miss your train.
If you don't hurry, you'll miss your train.
If you don’t hurry up, you will miss your train.
If you don’t hurry up, you'll miss your train.
If you don’t hurry, you will miss your train.
If you don’t hurry, you'll miss your train.
explanation_ru: Реальное условие о будущем: после if — Present Simple (do not hurry), а результат — will miss.

prompt: I can send the form to the office for you if you ___ it by Friday.
explanation_ru: К пятнице действие должно быть завершено, поэтому после if нужен Present Perfect (have finished); will и would после if нельзя.

prompt: — Where will you stay in Wroclaw? — If the hotel (to be) full, we (to stay) with my aunt.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple (is), а результат — will stay.

prompt: Parisa asked an engineer to repair her heating. He may come today, but he may not. She is going shopping for an hour and talks to her neighbour.
options: If the engineer will come, please give him my key.
When the engineer will come, please give him my key.
If the engineer comes, please give him my key.
When the engineer came, please give him my key.
explanation_ru: Приход мастера неизвестен, поэтому if; после if нужен Present Simple (comes), а не will.

prompt: The teacher says to the class: The coach leaves at eight tomorrow. If you (to be) late, we (not / to wait) for you. Please ring me if you (to have) a problem. I will give the list to the driver at half past seven.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple (are, have), а результат — will not wait.

prompt: Sort the sentences from Yasmin's holiday chat: real world or inside-out world?

items.text: If it is cold tomorrow, we will wear coats.
If the ferry is late, we take the next one.
If you press that button, the lift goes down.
If we had a bigger car, we would take your parents too.
If I were taller, I could reach the top shelf.
If we had left earlier, we would have caught the ferry.

explanation_ru: Present Simple и will описывают реальный мир, а Past Simple + would и Past Perfect + would have — нереальный мир (сейчас или в прошлом).

prompt: Which group does each sentence belong to?

items.text: If I drink tea at night, I cannot sleep.
If the baby hears music, she stops crying.
If the rain stops, we will go for a walk.
If Dad is late, I will start dinner.
If I had a dog, I would walk it every day.
If my room were bigger, I would have a desk.

explanation_ru: Present Simple в обеих частях — привычка, if + Present Simple и will — возможное будущее, Past Simple и would — воображаемая ситуация сейчас.

prompt: Wanjiru's train was cancelled this morning, so she missed an important meeting. Now she talks to her friend.
options: If the train weren't cancelled, I would reach the meeting.
If the train hadn't been cancelled, I would have reached the meeting.
If the train isn't cancelled, I will reach the meeting.
If the train wouldn't be cancelled, I would have reached the meeting.
explanation_ru: Речь о прошлом, которое нельзя изменить, поэтому нужны Past Perfect и would have + V3.

prompt: The bus drivers might go on strike tomorrow, but nobody knows yet. Teodor must be at the airport by nine, and he is deciding what to do.
options: If the buses stopped running, I will take a taxi.
If the buses will stop running, I take a taxi.
If the buses had stopped running, I would take a taxi.
If the buses stop running, I will take a taxi.
explanation_ru: Забастовка реально возможна, поэтому нужно реальное условие: if + Present Simple, will в главной части.

prompt: Rasa's school finishes in July. Her uncle asks about her summer plans.
options: When school will finish, I will visit my cousin in Wales.
When school finishes, I would visit my cousin in Wales.
When school finishes, I will visit my cousin in Wales.
When school finished, I will visit my cousin in Wales.
explanation_ru: Конец учёбы наступит наверняка, поэтому when; после when — Present Simple (finishes), а в главной части — will visit.

prompt: Quentin's old bike has a broken brake, and he has no money for a new one. If he (to have) more money, he (to buy) a new bike today. He will ask his uncle for help on Saturday. If his uncle (to say) yes, Quentin (to go) to the shop on Sunday.
explanation_ru: Денег сейчас нет — нереальное условие (had, would buy); просьба к дяде реальна — if + Present Simple (says) и will go.

prompt: Zsofia missed the last train home on Friday night. If she (to leave) the party ten minutes earlier, she (to catch) it. Instead, she had to walk home in the rain. Next weekend there is another party. If it (to finish) after eleven, she (to sleep) at her friend's flat.
explanation_ru: Прошлое, которое нельзя изменить, требует Past Perfect и would have caught; возможное будущее — if + Present Simple и will sleep.

prompt: Messages in a group chat about a picnic.
sentences: If the weather is fine on Saturday, we will have the picnic by the river.
If it will rain, we will move everything to Sadia's flat.
Her flat is small; if it were bigger, we would invite the whole class.
Last year it rained all day, and if we had brought umbrellas, we would have stayed dry.
If I would know the forecast now, I would tell you.

fixes.1: If it rains, we will move everything to Sadia's flat.
fixes.4: If I knew the forecast now, I would tell you.

explanation_ru: В предложении 2 после if стоит will вместо Present Simple, а в предложении 5 — would вместо Past Simple (If I knew).

prompt: A worker's message to colleagues about the broken heating.
sentences: If the heating had worked on Monday, the office would not have been so cold.
If I were the manager, I would fix it today.
If the repair team comes tomorrow, we will have warm rooms by the evening.
If the team had come last week, we are not freezing now.
Anyway, I will bring a warm jumper tomorrow.

fixes.3: If the team had come last week, we would not be freezing now.

explanation_ru: В предложении 4 условие относится к прошлому, а результат — к настоящему, поэтому в главной части нужно would not be, а не are not.

prompt: Mustafa does not know the way to the new office, so he cannot come. If he ___ the way, he would come.
explanation_ru: Сейчас Мустафа не знает дорогу, поэтому нужно нереальное условие: if + Past Simple (knew).

prompt: I am not sure the post office will be open on Monday. ___ it is open, I will send the parcel; otherwise I will try on Tuesday.
explanation_ru: Неизвестно, будет ли почта открыта, поэтому нужно if; when означало бы, что она точно откроется.

prompt: My neighbour is very noisy. If he would be quieter, I could sleep better.
answer: My neighbour is very noisy. If he were quieter, I could sleep better.
accepted_answers: My neighbour is very noisy. If he were quieter, I could sleep better.
My neighbour is very noisy. If he was quieter, I could sleep better.
explanation_ru: После if не ставится would: для нереальной ситуации сейчас нужен Past Simple (were или was).

prompt: Ismail did not wear his helmet and hurt his head. If he (to wear) it, he (not / to hurt) his head.
explanation_ru: Это прошлое, которое нельзя изменить: Past Perfect после if и would not have + V3 в главной части.

prompt: If Dad had a car, he would drive us to school.
options: Dad has a car and drives us to school.
Dad does not have a car, so he does not drive us to school.
Dad had a car but did not drive us to school.
Dad did not have a car, but he drove us to school.
explanation_ru: If + Past Simple и would показывают нереальную ситуацию сейчас: на самом деле у папы нет машины, и он нас не возит.
